# Keep the non-PIE linker flag after the default PIE flag

The Clang 18 follow-up uses -no-pie for all compilers and leaves it in OS_LIBS so it comes after MOZ_PROGRAM_LDFLAGS -pie. The prior clang-specific -nopie branch was removed. D210720 was accepted, then the paired Clang 18 ports were backed out and relanded as upstream state changed. This is a file-specific link-order contract, not a general preference for OS_LIBS.

Scope: Clang build configuration.

Paths:

- `mail/app/no-pie/moz.build`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/da4126d6b4a06e7af9baecf52d0a588c7b5ee9eb37ff53d9b551e3fa2b00cc2c.json).

- https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/8f544ea403a0
- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1891452
- https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D210720

Source record: `1744682e77a53e871af3a609e6485666c81404ce8e480db6a953ab8ae2baff0b`

~~~
OS_LIBS += [
    "-no-pie",
]
~~~

Status: **supported**. This backfill preserves earlier findings and their uncertainty. It does not count unstudied commits as complete. Historical test outcomes remain reported outcomes. No runtime tests or builds were rerun for publication.

Some source material is an older import or lacks independent public-access confirmation. Its useful lesson is included as recorded context. Raw personal transcripts stay outside this repository.
